title: Length of Service Share on Utility Pass-Through Service Late Fees — Decision Table
content:
**Rule.** For a late fee on a Utility Pass-Through Service statement, an account whose service began 120 or more whole months before the handling date takes a tenure share of 80 percent, and one whose service began 60 to 119 whole months before takes 90 percent. A newer account takes no tenure share.

Service began on the account's service start date; whole months are counted from that date to the handling date. The share multiplies the fee basis — the amount the statement's late fee is figured from — before the fee is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Decision table

| Whole months from service start to the handling date | Tenure share |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 80 percent |
| 60 to 119 | 90 percent |
| 59 or fewer | none |

## Boundaries (handling date 3 June, hypothetical)

| Service start date | Whole months | Tenure share |
|---|---|---|
| 3 June, ten years earlier | 120 | 80 percent |
| 4 June, ten years earlier | 119 | 90 percent |
| 3 June, five years earlier | 60 | 90 percent |
| 4 June, five years earlier | 59 | none |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** Fee basis 12.00 on an account in service for 7 years (84 whole months): 12.00 times 90 percent is 10.80.
